technical.summary: Multiple oversold indicators suggest potential bounce, but bearish price structure (below all MAs, three black crows, downside breakout) and weak momentum confluence make this a low-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 34 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no clear conviction; fear sentiment (37) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and neutral AAII reading limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 84.7 crisis level, rising USD, FOMC event today) creates severe headwinds for MMM; earnings in 34 days adds moderate event risk but secondary to acute market dysfunction.

debate.key_bull_argument: Multiple oversold oscillators (Stochastic, Williams %R, UO) at extreme levels suggest mean-reversion bounce potential, and fear sentiment (37) presents contrarian opportunity if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX 84.7 crisis, inverted yield curve, FOMC today, rising USD), price structure deeply bearish (below all MAs, three black crows, DC10 downside breakout), zero fundamental catalysts, and earnings risk in 34 days make this a low-probability entry in a dysfunctional market.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold oscillators present theoretical bounce potential, but macro crisis (VIX 84.7, inverted yield curve, FOMC today) and severe bearish price structure (below all MAs, three black crows, DC10 breakout down) create unacceptable risk/reward in a dysfunctional market.
decision.primary_risk: Macro dysfunction (FOMC event today, VIX crisis, inverted yield curve) could trigger further capitulation; earnings in 34 days add event risk on top of acute market stress.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical oversold signals insufficient to override macro and fundamental weakness
